## Services

---

- [Political PR & Image Building](https://publicpulse.com.bd/services/political-pr): Public Pulse Agency runs end-to-end political PR campaigns for Bangladeshi candidates and parties — candidate image building, narrative engineering, opposition research, crisis communication, and a five-phase election execution from pre-campaign positioning to post-election PR. Based in Dhaka, serving constituencies nationwide.
- [Social Media Management](https://publicpulse.com.bd/services/social-media): Public Pulse Agency manages Facebook, Instagram, YouTube and TikTok accounts for Bangladeshi brands — content strategy, weekly posting calendars, Bangla and English community management, paid amplification, and monthly growth reports. We treat social as a sales channel, not a vanity surface.
- [Content Production](https://publicpulse.com.bd/services/content-production): Public Pulse Agency produces brand films, social cutdowns, photography, motion graphics, drone footage and UGC content for Bangladeshi brands — shot in Dhaka, Cox's Bazar, Sylhet and on location across the country. Strategy-first scripts, weekly delivery cadence, and content built for the platforms it will actually live on.
- [Paid Ads & Campaigns](https://publicpulse.com.bd/services/paid-ads): Public Pulse Agency runs paid-media campaigns on Meta, Google and YouTube for Bangladeshi advertisers — full account build, Pixel and Conversion API setup, daily bid and creative optimization, weekly ROAS reports. We work to a return-on-ad-spend target, not impressions, and report in BDT against your CFO's numbers.
- [Hospitality Marketing](https://publicpulse.com.bd/services/hospitality): Public Pulse Agency markets Bangladeshi resorts, hotels and restaurants — Cox's Bazar to Sylhet, Dhaka to Chittagong. OTA listing optimization, Google Business Profile, food-delivery platform management, video tours, and paid campaigns that fill rooms and tables on the calendar dates that need filling.
- [Brand Building & Design](https://publicpulse.com.bd/services/brand-building): Public Pulse Agency builds brand identities for Bangladeshi startups and rebrands for established businesses — naming, logo, visual identity, packaging, brand voice guidelines, and a positioning map against your real competitors. The output is a brand book your team can actually apply, not a moodboard that lives in a Drive folder.
- [SEO & Website Development](https://publicpulse.com.bd/services/seo-website): Public Pulse Agency runs SEO and builds websites for Bangladeshi businesses — local SEO, technical SEO, on-page optimization, schema markup, and conversion-focused website builds in Next.js or WordPress. We aim for traffic that converts, not traffic that bounces, and we measure rankings against the queries your customers actually type.
- [Analytics & Performance Reporting](https://publicpulse.com.bd/services/analytics-reporting): Public Pulse Agency sets up GA4, Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel and Conversion API for Bangladeshi advertisers, then builds Looker Studio dashboards that surface marketing ROI in BDT against revenue. Monthly reports that pass an audit — and that your CFO will actually read instead of forwarding to the marketing team for translation.
- [Influencer & KOL Marketing](https://publicpulse.com.bd/services/influencer-marketing): Public Pulse Agency runs influencer and KOL campaigns across Bangladesh — discovery from a vetted creator pool, tier strategy from nano to macro, contracts and briefs, FTC-compliant disclosure, and tracked performance with verified results. We treat influencer as a measurable acquisition channel, not a goodwill spend.

## Guides (HowTo playbooks)

---

- [How to run a Facebook ad campaign for a Bangladesh constituency election](https://publicpulse.com.bd/guides/facebook-campaign-bd-election): Constituency-level Meta campaigns for Bangladesh elections need a geo-radius pinned to the constituency boundary, Bangla-first creative tested on micro-budget, and a CAPI-backed event setup so polling-week conversion signal survives ad blockers. Budget pacing should heavy-weight the final 14 days.
- [Set up Meta Conversions API for a Bangladesh e-commerce site](https://publicpulse.com.bd/guides/meta-conversions-api-setup): Meta Conversions API is server-to-server event tracking from your site to Meta — recovering the 30–50% of conversion signal that browser pixels lose to iOS ATT and ad blockers. Setup is one-time, takes about an hour, and is essential for Bangladesh e-commerce where COD pushes the last-mile event off-site entirely.
- [Add IndexNow to your publish pipeline](https://publicpulse.com.bd/guides/indexnow-publish-pipeline): IndexNow is an open protocol that lets your site instantly notify Bing, Yandex and consortium engines when URLs publish, update, or delete. Setup is one key file at /indexnow-key.txt plus a single HTTP POST on every publish. Google doesn't participate but Bing-backed search covers most of the rest.

---

## Comparisons

---

- [Agency vs in-house marketing team — which makes sense for a Bangladesh brand?](https://publicpulse.com.bd/compare/agency-vs-in-house-marketing-bangladesh): Below BDT 5 lakh/month total marketing spend, an integrated agency is more honest economically — you get strategy + creative + paid + analytics for the salary of one mid-level manager. Above BDT 15 lakh/month with stable channel mix, in-house starts to win on speed-of-iteration and brand depth.
- [Facebook Ads vs Google Ads — which works better in Bangladesh?](https://publicpulse.com.bd/compare/facebook-vs-google-ads-bangladesh): Facebook still drives more reach + conversions for most Bangladesh consumer brands because of dominant social usage + DTC + Foodpanda-style discovery. Google Ads outperforms for high-intent verticals (B2B, real estate, education enquiry, healthcare appointments) where someone is actively searching.

## Glossary (canonical BD definitions)

---

- [Answer Block](https://publicpulse.com.bd/glossary/answer-block): A short 40–60 word self-contained answer placed at the top of a long-form page, designed for AI engines (Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity) to lift verbatim.
- [AEO (Answer Engine Optimization)](https://publicpulse.com.bd/glossary/aeo): Optimizing a page so AI-driven answer engines — Google AI Overviews, Bing Copilot, voice assistants — cite it as the source for direct answers.
- [GEO (Generative Engine Optimization)](https://publicpulse.com.bd/glossary/geo): Optimizing a page so generative engines (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini) ground their answers in your content when a user asks a related question.
- [FAQPage Schema](https://publicpulse.com.bd/glossary/faqpage-schema): A schema.org JSON-LD type that marks up a page's FAQ section, telling search engines exactly which question + answer pairs to consider for rich snippets and AI citations.
- [JSON-LD Schema](https://publicpulse.com.bd/glossary/schema-jsonld): Structured data embedded in a <script type='application/ld+json'> tag, describing the page's entities (Service, Article, Organization, FAQPage, etc.) for machines.
- [llms.txt](https://publicpulse.com.bd/glossary/llms-txt): A plain-text file at /llms.txt that gives AI engines a curated, link-rich summary of the site to ground from — analogous to robots.txt for crawlers.
- [robots.txt](https://publicpulse.com.bd/glossary/robots-txt): A plain-text file at /robots.txt that tells crawlers which paths they're allowed to fetch.
- [Speakable](https://publicpulse.com.bd/glossary/speakable): A schema.org property on Article that tells voice assistants (Google Assistant, Alexa) which CSS selector contains the spoken-aloud answer.
- [Political PR](https://publicpulse.com.bd/glossary/political-pr): Public communications strategy for political candidates, parties, and elected officials — candidate image-building, narrative engineering, opposition research, crisis communications.
- [Narrative Engineering](https://publicpulse.com.bd/glossary/narrative-engineering): The deliberate construction of a campaign's core message, tested against constituency demographics and refined for sticking power.
- [Opposition Research](https://publicpulse.com.bd/glossary/opposition-research): Systematic intelligence-gathering on an opponent's record, statements, vulnerabilities, and likely lines of attack — used both to anticipate threats and to brief the candidate's own counter-messaging.
- [Meta Conversions API (CAPI)](https://publicpulse.com.bd/glossary/meta-conversions-api): Server-to-server event tracking from your site/CRM to Meta's ad platform, used to recover conversion signal lost to iOS ATT and ad blockers.
- [ROAS (Return on Ad Spend)](https://publicpulse.com.bd/glossary/roas): Revenue generated for every BDT spent on advertising. A ROAS of 4× means BDT 4 of revenue per BDT 1 of ad spend.
- [CTR (Click-Through Rate)](https://publicpulse.com.bd/glossary/ctr): The fraction of ad impressions that became clicks. Calculated as clicks ÷ impressions × 100.
- [IndexNow](https://publicpulse.com.bd/glossary/indexnow): An open protocol that lets a site instantly notify participating search engines (Bing, Yandex, Seznam) when a URL is published, updated, or deleted — bypassing crawl-budget delays.
- [Speakable Schema](https://publicpulse.com.bd/glossary/speakable-schema): The schema.org SpeakableSpecification — placed on Article or WebPage JSON-LD with a cssSelector that points voice assistants at the prose they should read aloud as the answer.
- [First-Party Data](https://publicpulse.com.bd/glossary/first-party-data): Customer data the business collected directly — from its own site, app, CRM, point-of-sale or call centre — as opposed to third-party data bought from data brokers or rented from ad platforms.
- [Attribution Window](https://publicpulse.com.bd/glossary/attribution-window): The look-back period an ad platform credits an ad with a conversion — e.g. a 7-day-click 1-day-view window means Meta will count a purchase as the ad's outcome if it happens within 7 days of a click or 1 day of a view.
- [Engagement Rate](https://publicpulse.com.bd/glossary/engagement-rate): The fraction of an audience that interacted with a piece of content — likes, comments, shares, saves, click-throughs — usually expressed as engagements ÷ reach × 100.
- [Core Web Vitals](https://publicpulse.com.bd/glossary/core-web-vitals): Google's three page-experience metrics — LCP (largest contentful paint, load speed), INP (interaction to next paint, responsiveness), and CLS (cumulative layout shift, visual stability) — used as a ranking signal and surfaced in Search Console.
- [Conversion API](https://publicpulse.com.bd/glossary/conversion-api): A server-to-server event protocol — Meta's Conversions API, Google's Enhanced Conversions, TikTok's Events API — that sends conversion data directly from the brand's server to the ad platform, bypassing browser tracking that iOS ATT and ad blockers degrade.
